entries.title: Initial
entries.description: Writing maintenance emails at work requires repetitive information. By using the mailto: function, the work can be reduced from 5 minutes per entry to under a minute.

entries.title: Settings
entries.description: To prevent the code storing the email for maintenance, a setting menu was added to store it in localStorage. To do this I wanted a toggle on click effect that would switch from just displaying, to editing the value.
